Description: Collected MIMII, CWRU and public IB datasets.
Organized datasets into separate project folders.
Loaded WAV, MAT and CSV-compatible data using Python.
Checked missing values, infinite values and duplicate samples.
Analyzed class distribution, signal statistics and feature ranges.
Extracted Mean, Standard Deviation, Min, Max and RMS.
Applied FFT to extract dominant frequency, FFT magnitude, spectral energy and spectral centroid.
Combined time-domain and frequency-domain features for IB.
Checked the number of samples available for each class.
Used stratified splitting for the IB model experiment.
Fitted the scaler only on training data to avoid data leakage.
Trained a Random Forest using five time-domain features.
Trained a Random Forest using five time-domain plus four FFT features.
Used 5-fold Stratified Cross-Validation to evaluate model stability.
Evaluated training, validation and held-out test performance.
Selected the 9-feature Random Forest as the final baseline.
Saved the final Random Forest model and feature list.
